labels: The photograph includes the student's head, torso and upper thighs, with the lower frame cutting across both thighs above the knees.; 사진에 학생의 머리와 몸통 및 허벅지 위쪽이 들어오고 화면 아래가 무릎 위에서 두 허벅지를 가로지른다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The photograph includes the student's head, torso and upper thighs, with the lower frame cutting across both thighs above the knees.
